title: Bokeh + Pandas
intro: These interactive charts analyze over 20,000 AirBnb listings using Python's Pandas library and Bokeh visualization tools.

heatmap.title: Correlation Heatmap
heatmap.description: Shows how different listing features relate to each other. Yellow squares indicate strong positive relationships (when one increases, the other does too), while purple squares show negative relationships.
heatmap.code: Correlation analysis using Pandas and Bokeh:

pie.title: Room Type Distribution
pie.description: A pie chart showing the breakdown of different accommodation types (entire homes, private rooms, shared rooms). This helps understand what kinds of spaces are most commonly listed.
pie.code: Room distribution using the SAME cached data:

jitter.title: Price Analysis
jitter.description: Displays how prices vary across different room types. Each dot represents a listing, allowing you to see the price range and distribution for each accommodation category.

bar.title: Top Hosts
bar.description: Bar chart showing the 10 most active hosts by number of listings. This reveals which hosts manage the most properties on the platform.

lollipop.title: Neighborhood Activity
lollipop.description: Lollipop chart displaying listing counts by neighborhood. The length of each line shows how many properties are available in different areas of the city.

whatPandas.title: What is Pandas?
whatPandas.description: Pandas is Python's most popular data analysis library. It provides DataFrames - powerful table-like structures that make it easy to clean, transform, and analyze large datasets. Think of it as Excel on steroids, but programmable and capable of handling millions of rows.

dataset.title: The Dataset
dataset.intro: We're analyzing 20,837 AirBnb listings from a real-world dataset. Each row contains information like:
dataset.roomType: Room type (entire home, private room, shared)
dataset.reviews: Number of reviews and review scores

patterns.title: Data Analysis Patterns
patterns.intro: Each chart demonstrates common Pandas operations:
patterns.correlation: Correlation: df.corr() finds relationships between numeric columns
patterns.filtering: Filtering: df[df.price < 500] selects subsets of data

loading.title: Loading Data
loading.description: The CSV is loaded using Pandas' read_csv() function with PyScript's HTTP fetch. The first chart loads the data, then subsequent charts reuse the cached DataFrame - no redundant network requests!

whyBokeh.title: Why Bokeh?
whyBokeh.description: Bokeh excels at creating interactive visualizations directly from Pandas DataFrames. Unlike static charts, Bokeh plots let you pan, zoom, and hover to explore the data. It's perfect for exploratory data analysis and dashboards.
